equipmentSystem.description: Equipment is permanently owned during a run and can be purchased repeatedly. Duplicate items stack their effect.
designRules: Equipment should primarily provide incremental scaling rather than major rule changes.
Rule-changing effects should generally be reserved for Relics or spells.
Avoid excessive random proc effects so combat remains understandable.
Domain equipment may synergize with a domain but does not require that domain to be equipped.
